d:
CRPF (Central Reserve Police Force) completed a year without any operational fatality, for the first time in 47 years.
Episode 1930 looks at CRPF’s journey, its evolution and what its fatality-free operational year reflects. ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta also explains the force’s role in India’s internal security.
